lines.en: I slip along the wall, fast.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面移动，没有声音。
lines.en: I move low and silent.
I hide behind the door for you.
My shape is like a person's shadow.
I flick from here to there.
I circle to the edge of your sight.
I move along the wall; it's cold.

lines.zh: 我经过你背后，你没有回头。
lines.en: I pass behind you, and you don't turn.
I move straight, like a sheet of paper.
I pause at the stairhead.
I creep out of the corner.

lines.zh: 我立在那里，像一张剪影。
lines.en: I stand there like a cut-out shadow.
My edges tremble slightly.
I have no face; you can't make it out.
I'm waiting for that one turn of your head.
I press to the wall, very thin.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，像挂着的纸。
lines.en: I hold still like hanging paper.
I remember the look you just had.
I'm finding the best spot.

lines.zh: 我不需要站着，我只需要出现。
lines.en: I needn't stand; I only need to appear.

lines.zh: 我的影子比我的身体实在。
lines.en: My shadow is more solid than I am.
My head tips over, slowly.
I turn sideways, thinner.

lines.zh: 我在数这间屋子有几扇门。
lines.en: I count the doors in this room.
You turned back; too fast.

lines.zh: 我就在你左边的空气里。
lines.en: I'm in the air to your left.
I copy the way you stand.
Half a step back — now I see you.
I say nothing; I have no voice.

lines.zh: 你的影子和我差不多高。
lines.en: Your shadow is about my height.

lines.zh: 我从你眼角边上冒出来。
lines.en: I rise at the corner of your eye.
My head leans at an angle toward you.
I don't intend to explain who I am.
The longer you look, the clearer I get.
I lift one hand to shoulder height.

lines.zh: 你的手指在袖口里发抖。
lines.en: Your fingers shake inside your cuff.
I want to see if you'll run.
I'm within one step of you.
Your eyes have nowhere to rest.
I stand outside the light.
Do you hear the paper sound?
I thin out, then darken again.
My edge curls.
I give half a step and cling to the wall.
That scattered me a little.
I tremble, my shape askew.
I can't cry out; I can only retreat.
I go thin, almost transparent.

lines.zh: 我把散开的部分收回来。
lines.en: I draw my scattered parts back.
I slowly straighten up.
I'm still here; don't rush.
The faster you breathe, the closer I get.
That light is in the way.

lines.zh: 我朝你那边斜过去一点。
lines.en: I lean a little your way.
Your back is already at the corner.
What you hold clicks softly.
Stay a moment longer.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西……能让我更像你。
lines.en: That thing in your hand... could make me more like you.

lines.zh: 别怕，我只是想借你的样子用用。
lines.en: Don't be scared — I just want to borrow your shape.

lines.zh: 你撞上我，像穿过一层纸。
lines.en: You hit me like passing through paper.
I scatter a little and gather.

lines.zh: 我的手搭上你的肩，冰凉。
lines.en: My hand settles on your shoulder, ice-cold.
You pull back; I haven't moved.
I stand pressed to your back.

lines.zh: 你从我身上穿过去，我转过脸。
lines.en: You pass through me; I turn my face.

lines.zh: 我被撞得歪了，慢慢立正。
lines.en: I'm knocked askew and slowly straighten.
My edge curls up.
One touch, and I fade a little.
Another cut-out stands in the doorway.
Her outline is thinner than mine.

lines.zh: 我们并排站着，像两个人。
lines.en: We stand side by side, like two people.
She tilts her head, copying me.
We wait together for you to turn.
Her edges tremble too.

lines.zh: 我们重叠了一下，又分开。
lines.en: We overlap once, then part.

lines.zh: 我们没有声音可以交换。
lines.en: We have no voices to exchange.
Two shadows, one doorway.
She's more patient than I am.
I pick up your lamp and blow it out.
I press down what you dropped.
I turn that mirror face down.

lines.zh: 我用纸一样的边角挑起它。
lines.en: I lift it on a paper-thin edge.

lines.zh: 我把你的帽子摆正在桌上。
lines.en: I set your hat straight on the table.

lines.zh: 我把门缝里塞的纸抽出来。
lines.en: I pull the paper from under the door.

lines.zh: 我拾起一枚钉子，藏起来。
lines.en: I pick up a nail and hide it.
I wipe out the writing on the floor.
I move the candle further away.
I take the cloth and cover the lamp.
You turned; I'm here.
Too close — stand still.
I raise a hand; you shouldn't look.
I hear your steps clearly.
This room holds only us.
I come out from behind the door.

lines.zh: 我看见你的影子停在原处。
lines.en: I see your shadow stop.
I've picked a good spot.
This time I don't slip back into the wall.
I appear on three.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸太响，我听见了。
lines.en: Your breathing is loud; I hear it.
I lower my head, copying you.
The instant you turn is best.
Did you hear? Right behind you.
One step from you, one from me, close behind.
Each step of yours, I gain.
I flatten against the doorframe.
You stop, and I stop.

lines.zh: 你的手摸向腰间的武器。
lines.en: Your hand reaches for your belt.
I slowly grow clearer.
You back to the stairs; I block them.
My shadow reaches the wall first.
I make no sound, yet you hear me.
I wait for you to blow the lamp out.
You're counting the lamps left.
I slip along the wall past you.

lines.zh: 你的脚在门槛上绊了一下。
lines.en: You stumble on the threshold.
I stop one step behind you.
Any closer and you'll turn.
You feel the cold, don't you?

lines.zh: 我就贴在这面墙上，等你回头。
lines.en: I'll stay flat against this wall until you look back.
This room has four corners.
I reach from behind and seize you.
My hand passes through your collar.

lines.zh: 我一使劲，你贴到了墙上。
lines.en: One shove and you're flat on the wall.
My fingers are cold and sharp.
You turn, and I'm right before your face.

lines.zh: 我扣住你的腕子，凉得很。
lines.en: I clamp your wrist, ice-cold.
That was light, like a paper cut.

lines.zh: 我压住你的手，让你举不起灯。
lines.en: I hold your hand so you can't raise the lamp.
You pull away; I press back in.
I cling to your back and stay.

lines.zh: 你抓不到我，我只能被抓到。
lines.en: You can't grab me; I can only be caught out.
I press your lamp out.
You didn't hear that one.
I slip back into the dark, quickly.
I hear every one of your gasps.
I smile, without a sound.

lines.zh: 墙上多了一个人的轮廓。
lines.en: A person's outline appears on the wall.

lines.zh: 我从纸一样的边缘立起来。
lines.en: I rise from a paper edge.

lines.zh: 这个角落刚才还是空的。
lines.en: This corner was empty a moment ago.
When the lamp went out, I was there.
I slowly gain a little thickness.

lines.zh: 我站在你刚才看过的位置。
lines.en: I stand where you just looked.

lines.zh: 我没有脚步声，所以你没发现。
lines.en: I have no footsteps, so you didn't notice.
Enough shadow here to hide in.
I raise my head, my shape clear.
I stay still until you come near.
This room is very quiet.

lines.zh: 我把手从阴影里伸出来。
lines.en: I reach a hand out of the shadow.
I cling to the wall and slide.
The lamp in this house is dim.

lines.zh: 我从天花板的暗处垂下来。
lines.en: I hang down from the ceiling's dark.
The moment I appear, the dog stops barking.
I stand a little narrower than the doorframe.
I wait for you to shut the door.

lines.zh: 我的轮廓刚好填满门缝。
lines.en: My outline fills the gap under the door.
The firelight takes a layer off me.

lines.zh: 我从墙上滑下来，落成一张纸。
lines.en: I slide off the wall and land as a sheet.

lines.zh: 水把我化开了，我慢慢聚。
lines.en: Water dissolves me; I gather slowly.

lines.zh: 气浪把我吹散，我散成一片。
lines.en: The blast blows me apart into a sheet.

lines.zh: 箭在剪影上戳了个洞，边缘卷起。
lines.en: The arrow punches a hole in my silhouette, edges curling.
A light pins me to the wall.

lines.zh: 我什么都不吃，只是变淡了。
lines.en: I eat nothing; I only fade.

lines.zh: 雷光把屋子照白，我几乎没了。
lines.en: Lightning whites the room; I'm nearly gone.
There's no wall here to hang on.
